title: Padded tuple equivalence
statement: Let $a,r,M\in\mathbb{N}$ with $a\le r$. A function from the first $r$ indices to the first $M$ indices is equivalent to a pair consisting of its restriction to the first $a$ indices and its restriction to the remaining indices.
